title: Hyder ke Matamdaaro me hyder ka janaaza
body:
1. Hyder Asws. Ke Matamdaro'n Mein Hyder Asws. Ka Janaza Uth-ta Hai.
pehlu Ko Sambhale Roti Hui Purse Ko Aayi Zehra S.a. Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sajde Mein Ibne Muljim L.a. Ne Talwaar Chalayi Dhoke Se.
do Neem Hua Sar Hyder Asws. Ka, Fawwara Qoon Ka Behta Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Meesam As., Salma'n A.s., Meqdaad A.s., Kumail A.s, Malik A.s., Ammar A.s., Abuzar A.s. Bhi.
daale Hue Sar Par Qaake Aza, Har Ek Sahabi Rota Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tha Waqte Naz'aa Moula Ka Mere, Saasa R.a., Ne Kiye Us Waqt Sawaal.
is Karb Ke Aalam Mein Bhi Ali Asws., Paigham E Quda Jjh. Pohonchata Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Shabbar Asws. Ke Hawale Sabko Kiya, Rote Hai Tadapkar Shahe Wafa Asws.
abbas Asws. Se Bole Shere Quda Asws., Shabbir Asws. Tumhara Aaqa Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jaate Hue Hyder Asws. Kufe Ke Logo Se Wasiyat Karte Hai.
zainab Asws. Ko Meri Tum Yaad Rakho Phir Lout Ke Isko Aana Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Qatil L.a. Ko Sheer Diya Tumne, Aur Bande Rasan Bhi Khulwaye.
zainab S.a. Ke Bazu Sheh Ka Gala, Kya Yaad Ali Asws. Ko Aaya Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Do Baar Janaza Ut-ttha Hai, Hyder Asws. Ka Shehr E Koofa Mein.
hai Karbobala Mein Lashe Pidar, Zanjeer Mein Jakda Beta Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Koozo'n Mein Doodh Liye Bache, Moula Ki Ayaadat Ko Aaye.
par Dashte Bala Mein Sheer Kaha'n Pani Bhi Waha'n Par Mehenga Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Beto'n Se Kehte Hai Moula, Aawaz Na Ghairo'n Tak Pohonche.
kulsoom S.a. Aur Zainab S.a. Ka Rona, Hyder Asws. Ko Bohot Tadpata Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Shahzade Ki Yeh Anjuman Moula Ke Matam Ko Aayi.
meyaar Hamara Kya Ho Bayaa'n Zehra S.a. Ne Dua Mein Maanga Hai.
